scientific_integrity: All asymptotic assertions follow from a mathematical proof; finite tests are independent checks, not a substitute for infinite coverage. No historical novelty certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for three ordered equally likely symbols under synchronous cyclic width-three median; it admits a lattice rather than unrestricted continuous limit. Classical early median-filter literature includes a potentially covering historical risk, though no equivalent result was identified. Independent external validation has not occurred.
title: A coupled-threshold Poisson clock for ternary circular median dynamics
